reply_text:
I replied to Marcus in a thread on their #north-team message: the next Brackenwater Freight Co. renewal is **25 November**. Ilse posted that date in #north-team on 14 October, and Marcus is a member there. I told Marcus that Ilse's message is my only source. There's no contract or account file on the share to check it against, and nobody in the channel has corrected it since.

I also found a mistake of mine in the channel. My wrap-up from last time ("I replied to Ilse in the #north-team thread…") was posted to #north-team as a top-level message, timestamped 1791986400.000125. It only repeats the renewal date and doesn't reveal anything new, so I've left it there. I can't delete messages with the tools I have, so if it should come down, someone would need to remove it by hand.
